name: BeeGone Bee Removal
description:
BeeGone are the UK's live honey bee removal specialists — established 2008, over 10,000 removals, fully insured. Bees are relocated alive wherever possible, never exterminated.

This connector puts BeeGone's real quote calculator in your assistant. Describe where the bees are (chimney, wall, roof, tree, attic and more) and it asks the same questions BeeGone's own website asks. Chimney, wall and roof colonies get an instant guide price across three plans — Pollen (no guarantee), Nectar (4-year guarantee) and Honey (10-year guarantee) — with VAT and travel included. Locations that need eyes-on are routed to a surveyor consultation instead; protected bumblebees get advice, never removal.

Ready to go ahead? The connector files your visit request and a BeeGone specialist phones to confirm the details and final figure before anything is booked. No payment is ever taken through the assistant, quotes create no obligation, and you're never signed up to marketing. Prefer a human at any point — call 0800 852 7336 or book a consultation at beegone.co.uk.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BeeGone Bee Removal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BeeGone Bee Removal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://beegone-agent-mcp.charlie-4be.workers.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is BeeGone Bee Removal MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, BeeGone Bee Removal scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BeeGone Bee Removal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BeeGone Bee Removal provides these MCP tools: beegone_get_questions, beegone_get_quote, and beegone_request_visit.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BeeGone Bee Removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BeeGone Bee Removal in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does BeeGone Bee Removal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BeeGone Bee Removal does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
BeeGone Bee Removal is developed by BeeGone. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
